annotations.title: Investors: ask a startup founder for an intro through PitchSpark

description: For investors who found a startup to invest in: ask the founders of one PitchSpark pitch (by pitch_id) to connect, with a short message, through PitchSpark's in-app contact flow. Founders reply inside PitchSpark; their contact details are never returned. Returns status (requested, already_requested or quota_exhausted), intro_id and next_steps. Needs a PitchSpark API key (psk_...) from an investor account (self-declared; PitchSpark does not verify accreditation). PitchSpark does not verify investors or founders, does not recommend investments and takes no part in any resulting deal.

message.description: The investor's note to the founders: who they are and why they are interested. Up to 1000 characters are kept; emails, phone numbers, links and @handles are removed.

pitch_id.description: The "id" of a search or details result, copied exactly.

name: pitchspark_request_intro_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.
